ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels. Low-intensity pixels dominate the central and basal regions, while high-intensity pixels are concentrated in the lateral distal zones.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two distinct high-contrast contiguous white patches on the distal lateral 30% of each lobe. These patches exhibit dense, low-intensity speckling and mottling. The central 40% of the fluke surface is a contiguous low-intensity region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch estimated at 145 degrees; the depth of the depression is approximately 5% of the visible vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with sharp pixel-amplitude peaks across the entire trailing edge. Serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the left lobe compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the distal halves of the trailing edge, flaring upward towards the lateral tips; the transition from the median notch is relatively flat.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) localized strictly along the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips; visible irregular dark pitting/spotting within the white patch of the right lobe.
